bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). Balance sheet is the 31-March-2021 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2020 (audited, matches this bank's own 2020_Q4.json). Income-statement items are for Q1 itself. This filing's own primary statements are labelled plainly 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' (no 'Consolidated' or 'Solo' qualifier), and combine Main Operation with the Bank's own Off-shore Banking Unit (OBU, commenced 22-Oct-2020) -- there is no separate SBAC Bank Investment Limited subsidiary yet at this date (first appears from Q2-2021 onward, see that quarter's period_note), so this filing is unambiguously Solo/Standalone. Total assets (88,451,678,167), total liabilities (78,882,614,817) and total equity (9,569,063,350, confirmed both by total_assets-minus-total_liabilities and by summing the four reported equity components, which agree exactly) all reconcile. This is the FIRST quarter in this bank's archive with a full notes package (39 notes) including a granular loan-classification and required-provision disclosure (Note 8.4/8.5), last seen only in FY2023-2025 filings until now -- EARLIER REGULATORY-FORBEARANCE LETTER FOUND, extending this dataset's already-documented multi-year forbearance pattern (2023/2024/2025 letters) back to 2021: Note 8.4's own footnote cites Bangladesh Bank letter ref. DBI-1/132/2021-1002 dated 05 April 2021, which allowed the Bank to maintain total provision of Tk.1,450.58m in FY2020 against a required Tk.2,020.52m, deferring the Tk.569.94m gap equally over 2021-2023; by 31-March-2021 the (now-shrinking) deferred gap stood at Tk.371.44m (provision required 1,995,256,568 vs maintained 1,623,814,302). Classified loans (Note 8.5, Main Operation + OBU) were Tk.3,492,962,039 (NPL 6.06%) against total loans and advances of Tk.57,683,117,640. No capital-adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosure in this filing (all 39 notes checked) -- Basel III Pillar III disclosures remain annual-report-only. BAS-33 RESTATEMENT MECHANISM: this filing's own Note 36 restates the Q1-2020 comparative EPS to 0.33 (PAT 224,556,600 / CURRENT 684,645,517 shares), differing from Q1-2020's own contemporaneous EPS of 0.36 (2020_Q1.json, using that quarter's own 622,405,016 shares) -- the same enlarged-share-count restatement pattern already documented elsewhere in this dataset; this dataset's own 2020_Q1.json keeps that quarter's first-published figure.
